Name: StardewHitboxes
Author: TheTrain2000
Description:
Visualize the hitboxes of characters, farmers, and weapons!

Default toggle is F2. Options such as color, opacity, and toggle key can be configured in the mod's config file, or with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GenericModConfigMenu[/url].
